svg.title: VibeWave 2.1.0 — macOS Universal
svg.desc: Universal release for Apple Silicon (arm64) and Intel (x86_64). Local ad hoc signature, not notarized by Apple. DMG, PKG, ZIP and SHA-256 in the GitHub release, updates inside the app.

g.text: Local signature (ad hoc) · Not notarized by Apple
DMG · PKG · ZIP + SHA-256 · In-app auto-update
